description: Me! is like... girl what was that 😭😭 'spelling is fun'?? Brendon Urie?? This is the one song I pretend doesn't exist so I can keep stanning in peace 💅🏻 It's giving middle school talent show and I simply cannot defend it no matter how hard I try. We don't talk about this era, blondie had a moment of weakness and I forgive her but I'm not rating it high 🤭
